summary: IHG filed a Form 6-K attaching a UK TR-1 major holdings notification. PineStone Asset Management Inc. of Montreal reported that on 11-Sep-2026 its voting rights in the issuer fell to 10,314,124 shares, or 6.986425%, from a prior 7.929%, crossing below the 7% threshold, with no voting rights held through financial instruments. The issuer was notified 14-Sep-2026; the disclosure is an ordinary passive stake change, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, price, premium or deal mechanics. Watch for further TR-1 filings if PineStone's position moves across thresholds.
